description: Achieving functionality targets for seismically isolated steel buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Huy Pham, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). Under current provisions of ASCE 7-22, conventional structures typically achieve collapse risk targets, and higher performance objectives are enabled via the presence of an importance factor in the design process. However, for base isolated structures, no such process exists for the prescription of higher performing designs. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: seismic isolation, performance based design, damage and loss estimation. Published 2025-07-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
